title: Chaos in Klang Valley after downpour | The Star
text: Chaos in Klang Valley after downpour | The Star × View Nation Chaos in Klang Valley after downpour Monday, 16 Nov 2015 | 8:54 PM MYT share bookmark PETALING JAYA: A two hour downpour brought several areas in the Klang Valley to a standstill as flood waters rose and submerged cars and houses. Motorists going home from their offices were caught in a gridlock after the rain which started at about 3pm. Many were stranded on the road for several hours. Already a subscriber?
